key_catalyst: Escalating U.S.-Iran Tensions Drive Oil Higher and Fuel Risk-Off Sentiment
reasoning: Three open catalysts remain unresolved and are actively pressuring QQQ: escalating U.S.-Iran military conflict driving oil higher, a sharp semiconductor sell-off with no recovery, and elevated Treasury yields above 4.5%. The market has not absorbed these risks — pre-market on 7/16 is -0.95% and the prior session's intraday move was -0.96%, showing renewed weakness rather than stabilization.
